# Copilot Project Instructions

Read and follow [the shared instructions](../AGENTS.md) before working.
These agent definitions do not specify an application or its technology stack.

For coordinated implementation, select orchestrator and follow
[the delivery workflow](../agent-system/workflows/feature-delivery.md). For a direct question,
answer it without starting the delivery pipeline. Never pretend independent
delegation or test execution occurred when the tools were unavailable.

Roles and project context are separate. Do not invent project commands or a stack.
